_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/loot_window.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. The loot window (D142, D248) in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648; "at" is a top left corner, and a piece's "at" already counts its shadow. Draw in the order of "order"; text last. Text is drawn by Godot: "at" is the top left of the line (the top is the font's ascent line), "right" its top right, "centre" its top middle. Every place and size here is a setting. The window is one block on the right of the screen: in another window size it would keep to the right (not done).

slots._note: Each slot: "Slot <material>" at its place, the material of what it holds (Empty when nothing). The slot under the pointer, when it holds something: Slot Lit, its corner "lit" from the slot's. An item's pack picture (D237): the part "from" of the 256 x 256 picture, drawn "px" wide, its corner "picture" from the slot's. A count (coins, arrows, bandages: D124) right-aligned, its top right "count" from the slot's corner.

chest._note: What you opened: a slot's corner is first + step times its column and row. How many slots a chest has is not decided (12 here).

pack._note: Your pack: 12 slots, 20 with a backpack (D124).

note._note: The note on the item under the pointer, shown only while a chest slot that holds something is pointed at: Plate Note goes "dy" lower for each row below the first (it is drawn for the first row); its texts are placed from the plate's corner, which is at "corner" for the first row.

take_all._note: Takes everything that fits (D142, D124): a click, or Space.

owner._note: who owns what is inside (D35); the words are not decided

pack._note: "Pack", then "filled / slots" "gap" after it; at the right, "Coins" then the coins, the coins right-aligned and "Coins" "gap" before them.
pack.label: label
